claim.text: The Joining Forces alliance that Michelle and Jill Biden launched has already encouraged employers to hire or train nearly 400,000 veterans and military spouses.
claim.context: Michelle’s Let’s Move partnership with schools, businesses, and local leaders has helped bring down childhood obesity rates for the first time in thirty years – an achievement that will improve lives and reduce health care costs for decades to come. || The Joining Forces alliance that Michelle and Jill Biden launched has already encouraged employers to hire or train nearly 400,000 veterans and military spouses. || Taking a page from that playbook, the White House just organized a College Opportunity Summit where already, 150 universities, businesses, and nonprofits have made concrete commitments to reduce inequality in access to higher education – and help every hardworking kid go to college and succeed when they get to campus.

row.reasoning: Forced UNVERIFIABLE: the evidence pack failed the quality gate (too few qualifying Tier-1..3 sources bearing on the core assertion) after one targeted re-retrieval.

evidence.snippet: Official Joining Forces employment page documenting employer commitments to hire/train veterans and military spouses; primary source for the cumulative figure.
[2013-04-30] Official release says 290,000 hired/trained and 435,000 additional commitments, distinguishing actual outcomes from pledges.
[2013-08-10] Official WH fact sheet: ~290,000 veterans/spouses hired or trained via Joining Forces plus 435,000 in new commitments — the running tally approaching 400,000.
[2013-11-09] Official presidential weekly address: 290k hired/trained with commitment to over 400k more.
[2014-01-28] Established outlet reports SOTU: Joining Forces encouraged hire/train of nearly 400k.
[2014-02-10] Reports Obama statement: nearly 400k veterans/spouses hired under Joining Forces.
[2014-03-20] Official BLS 2013 veteran employment data provides labor-market context but does not measure Joining Forces hires.
